threat_event: Technician views or copies personal photos, messages, or account data from a customer device in the company's custody
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No rule limiting access to device contents; shared bench accounts; USB storage allowed; bench sessions not logged; passcodes visible on tickets and tags
affected_asset_or_process: Customer devices in custody; SYS-07; BP-02; BP-05
regulatory_driver: N81-R01 (15 U.S.C. 45(n)); N81-R02 (Fla. Stat. 501.171(1)(a); (2)); Manufacturer A agreement (contract)
existing_controls: Background checks; intake consent form; CCTV of bench areas (does not show screens)
treatment_plan: Customer data access standard (access only as the repair needs, with a test-mode checklist); named bench accounts; block USB storage; bench session logging; signed confidentiality agreement; sanctions

threat_event: Device passcodes and account passwords stored in ticket notes are exposed through any SYS-01 account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Passcodes (about 48,000 tickets) and account passwords (about 2,900 tickets) in a free-text field visible to all 60 users; paper tags show passcodes
existing_controls: MFA on named accounts from office PCs
treatment_plan: Stop collecting account passwords; collect passcodes only when the repair needs them, in the vendor's restricted field that is purged at release; purge historical notes; tags show ticket number only

threat_event: Shared counter login at Store C or D is phished and used to export customer records
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One shared SYS-01 login per store on counter tablets; no MFA; no export alerting
existing_controls: Counter tablets locked to the SYS-01 app
treatment_plan: Named accounts with MFA (tap badge plus PIN on tablets); export alerts; weekly export review

threat_event: Card numbers written on paper or in ticket notes during phone payments are exposed, and SAQ P2PE eligibility is lost
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Staff write card numbers before keying them; 37 tickets with full card numbers found; no training
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01; BP-06; paper at the Depot counter
regulatory_driver: N81-R03 (PCI DSS v4.0.1 3.2.1; 3.3.1.2; SAQ P2PE eligibility)
treatment_plan: Key card numbers directly into the terminal while on the call; purge the 37 notes and block card-number patterns in SYS-01 notes; training; quarterly search

threat_event: A PIN pad is tampered with or swapped for a skimming device
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: PIN pad inspections not scheduled or recorded; device list not reconciled with the processor
existing_controls: P2PE encryption; terminals on counters in view of staff
treatment_plan: Reconcile the 12 terminals with the processor list; weekly inspection log; staff training on tampering signs

threat_event: Recovered customer data kept indefinitely is stolen or exposed from the lab storage or bench PCs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 4.2 TB of recovered data from about 1,300 cases older than 90 days; transfer caches never wiped; no retention rule
existing_controls: Lab room locked; lab storage on the Depot network only
treatment_plan: 30-day retention after delivery with customer notice; purge the backlog; automatic cache wipe on bench PCs; encryption at rest on lab storage

threat_event: Data is recovered from a recycling drop-off device that was not properly sanitized
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No sanitization standard; no per-device record or verification; lot-level recycler certificates only
treatment_plan: Adopt SP 800-88 Rev. 2 methods (purge for devices that work; destroy otherwise); per-device certificate of sanitization; recycler contract with serial-level certificates

threat_event: Malware on a customer device spreads over the flat store network to bench and office PCs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Customer devices, bench PCs, counter tablets, and office PCs share one network per store; bench PCs have no EDR
existing_controls: EDR on office PCs; site firewalls
treatment_plan: Separate bench and customer-device VLAN with no route to office or counter networks; EDR on bench PCs with tool exclusions

threat_event: Former employee signs in to SYS-01 after leaving
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No access reviews; terminations handled by email; 7 former employees active (found in P07)
treatment_plan: Same-day disable from the HR ticket; quarterly access review of SYS-01 and manufacturer portals

threat_event: A repaired device is released to the wrong person, exposing the owner's data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No ID check or release checklist at busy counters
treatment_plan: Release checklist with photo ID or one-time code sent to the customer's phone; training

threat_event: Chatbot vendor retains transcripts containing passcodes and personal data or uses them to train models
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Chatbot launched without data-use terms; customers paste passcodes into chats
treatment_plan: Contract terms: no training on company data, 30-day transcript retention, breach notice; input filter that masks passcodes and card numbers; banner telling customers not to share passcodes

threat_event: Unsubstantiated AI accuracy claim and wrong AI diagnoses lead to unneeded repairs and deceptive-practice exposure
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Website claims 99% accuracy with no testing; no technician confirmation rule for AI suggestions
existing_controls: Technicians usually confirm faults before quoting
treatment_plan: Remove the claim now; technician confirmation before any quote; measure accuracy monthly (see P10)

threat_event: Business email compromise changes ACH details or sends fake invoices to business accounts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No phishing training; no call-back rule for payment changes
treatment_plan: Phishing training; call-back verification for any bank detail change

threat_event: Lab storage and its backups are encrypted or deleted together, so images and in-progress recoveries are lost
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Backup vault in the same cloud account; not immutable; never restore-tested
treatment_plan: Separate backup account with immutable retention; quarterly restore test; break-glass accounts

threat_event: Manufacturer A suspends authorized status after its audit finds a shared portal login and no incident notice process
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared Manufacturer A portal login at Store B; no 24-hour notice procedure; no technician access rules
treatment_plan: Named portal accounts before the October audit; notice procedure in P08; access standard (R-001)

threat_event: An incident is handled ad hoc and the Florida 30-day, acquirer 24-hour, and manufacturer 24-hour deadlines are missed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No incident response plan; staff do not know the notice terms
regulatory_driver: N81-R02 (Fla. Stat. 501.171(3); (4)); N81-R03 (PCI DSS v4.0.1 12.10.1); Manufacturer A agreement (contract)
treatment_plan: POL-03 and P08 runbook; notification matrix; tabletop exercise

threat_event: SYS-01 account is lost or corrupted and the vendor cannot restore it, leaving no copy of customer and ticket records
threat_source: Service provider failure or attacker with admin access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No company-held export; single SaaS dependency
existing_controls: Vendor backups per SOC 2 system description
treatment_plan: Weekly encrypted export to the backup account; confirm vendor RTO and RPO in the contract

threat_event: Unpatched store firewall firmware is exploited for remote access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Firmware updated only when problems occur; no vulnerability scanning
existing_controls: No management interface exposed to the internet
treatment_plan: Quarterly firmware updates; monthly external and internal scans

threat_event: Credential-stealing malware on a bench PC captures technician and portal credentials
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Bench PCs excluded from EDR; shared local accounts; customer files opened on bench PCs
treatment_plan: EDR on bench PCs; named accounts; bench PCs reimaged monthly

threat_event: Internet outage at a store stops intake and release
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single ISP at each store
existing_controls: Standalone P2PE terminals; paper intake forms
treatment_plan: Cellular hotspot kit per store

threat_event: A hurricane closes stores or the Depot for several days while customer devices are in custody
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No contingency plan; devices stored on open shelves; no plan to protect or return devices
treatment_plan: Contingency plan with storm procedures: secure devices in the Depot vault room, notify customers, relocate intake to an open store

threat_event: A courier loses a mail-in parcel containing a customer device with data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Courier contract has no loss-handling or data terms; no guidance to customers to back up and wipe where possible
treatment_plan: Mail-in instructions (back up; remove accounts where the repair allows); courier terms at renewal

threat_event: Background check reports on applicants are thrown away or left on old PCs without proper disposal
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Printed reports kept in unlocked HR files; no disposal procedure for consumer reports
treatment_plan: Keep reports in the HR SaaS only; shred printed copies; add to POL-04

threat_event: A recovered-data download link without expiry is forwarded or guessed and the data is accessed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Business account links never expire; links not tied to the recipient
existing_controls: Long random link identifiers; consumer links expire after 14 days
treatment_plan: 14-day expiry for all links; one-time code to the customer's phone for downloads

threat_event: Staff do not report a suspected incident or suspicious technician behavior, so notice clocks are missed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No reporting channel or training; the April 2026 complaint came from the customer, not staff
treatment_plan: Reporting line and anonymous option; training; no sanctions for good-faith reports

threat_event: Customer devices are stolen from a store back room after hours
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Devices awaiting pickup on open shelves; alarm only
treatment_plan: Locked cabinet for devices awaiting pickup

threat_event: A counter tablet is lost or stolen with a signed-in SYS-01 session
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Tablets not enrolled in device management; shared login stays signed in
treatment_plan: Enroll tablets in device management with remote wipe; named accounts (R-003)

threat_event: AI diagnostics accuracy is worse for some device brands, older devices, or Spanish-speaking chatbot users, leading to unfair quotes
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No accuracy testing by segment
treatment_plan: Segment accuracy testing in the P10 plan

threat_event: Chatbot vendor outage stops chat and status texts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single chatbot vendor
existing_controls: Phone line and status portal still work
treatment_plan: Accepted by the General Manager: residual risk Very Low

threat_event: Cloud administrator account taken over through credential theft
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Two administrators with standing access
existing_controls: MFA with number matching for both administrators; sign-in alerts
treatment_plan: Accepted by the General Manager: residual risk Low

threat_event: Attacker uses the default administrator password on the lab storage array's web console to read or delete customer images
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor default password on the storage array console, reachable from the Depot office network (found in P07 testing)
treatment_plan: Change the password now; restrict the console to the IT Manager's workstation; add to the configuration baseline
